method: Manually read every profile body and setup/environment fields, all four guides, relevant prior audits, profile display and authored choice structure. No analyzer installed/executed. No repository file edited. No external factual re-verification in this lane; observations concern current repo content.

rubric.present: Actionable within stated article scope. Prerequisites present means requirements identified, not every host combination proven.
rubric.partial: Useful guidance exists but reader must supply material steps/artifacts or diagnosis.
rubric.missing: No applicable procedure/result example/troubleshooting sequence. A screening observation, not automatically a defect.
rubric.steps: First-use procedure; named installation prerequisites can remain external.
rubric.expected_result: Action has observable intended result, not necessarily captured output.
rubric.interpretation: What finding/clean result establishes and does not establish.
rubric.adaptation: Project scope/configuration or modifying the specimen.
rubric.troubleshooting: Specific symptom/cause hints distinct from generic scope limits; no complete first-use troubleshooting sequence found.

strengths: Interpretation/limitations generally stronger than executable first-use material.
Illustrative examples and RTAMT provenance uncertainty labeled honestly.
Ruff, mypy, ASan, clang-tidy, ShellCheck and Kani offer strong editorial references.
No finding equates missing code blocks or lack of local execution with false documentation.

findings.title: First-use procedures remain uneven across the catalog
findings.user_task: Obtain a first interpretable tool result without inventing its entire setup
findings.observed: All 89 profiles identify setup/environment requirements, but 55 lack fenced examples. All 24 profiles from the catalog-expansion audit remain prose-only. Many describe what to choose but delegate concrete input, config, invocation and expected signal. Counts alone do not establish defects: CodeQL, Coverity Scan and Ghidra have useful prose workflows; GUI/licensed/historical entries should not be forced into CLI examples.
findings.impact: Readers can understand fit but still lack a complete first-result path, especially for property tests and verification harnesses.
findings.recommendation: Expand first-result guidance in task-driven batches, starting with Pyright, Hypothesis, CBMC, actionlint, detect-secrets and Memcheck. Supply a small fixture or exact maintained official tutorial, invocation/UI steps, expected evidence, correction and project adaptation.
acceptance_criteria: Identify prerequisite versions/platform scope without claiming untested compatibility.
Provide complete input-action-result-interpretation route and execution status.
Include faulty/corrected pair or equivalent observable state change proving intended check activation.
Do not require code blocks universally or call illustrative material executed.
dependencies: Choose representative environments before later executions
findings.prior_audit_status: Extends the four-profile usability pilot; not a regression or violation of optional decision-summary policy.

findings.title: API and protocol examples assume unavailable test infrastructure
findings.user_task: Try API/protocol testing locally and reproduce a known failure
findings.observed: boofuzz assumes a PING service and explicitly leaves failure monitoring/restart incomplete. RESTler assumes a resettable API, OpenAPI file, authentication and namespace. Schemathesis assumes a local service/schema. No tracked example/fixture/recipe directory supplies them. All accurately label the snippets illustrative.
findings.impact: The snippets do not form reproducible first experiments from the repo; readers must build substantial prerequisites.
findings.recommendation: Provide a loopback HTTP API fixture shared by Schemathesis and RESTler, including schema/startup/reset, one defect and correction, and replayable request. Keep boofuzz separate unless its PING target/monitor/reset are supplied.
acceptance_criteria: Target/schema available at one maintained location with documented supported launch/reset path.
Demo binds to loopback and documents state changes.
Show known failing/corrected behavior with tool-specific interpretation rather than raw-count comparison.
Later validation records target revision, tool version, command, output and execution status.
dependencies: Maintained example location and validation environment
findings.prior_audit_status: New completeness opportunity; existing illustrative boundary retained.

findings.title: Complementary choices stop before a reusable combined workflow
findings.user_task: Turn a shortlist into repeatable analysis of one project
findings.observed: Three workflow guides explain choices and limitations but provide no executable end-to-end recipe. Java asks readers to create shared faulty/corrected revisions; memory guidance describes fuzzer-plus-sanitizer roles without wiring a harness/build; temporal guidance describes model-monitor-search without supplying it. Python complements link separate pages without a shared specimen/configuration.
findings.impact: Readers perform the introduced integration themselves and may compare runs over different code or assumptions.
findings.recommendation: Create a reusable recipe format and start with Ruff plus mypy on one small project, shared revision, separate reports and explicit complementary claims. Queue native fuzzing-plus-sanitizer and API recipes after prerequisites exist. Link maintained procedures rather than copying them.
acceptance_criteria: One task, required artifacts and each tool role are explicit.
Commands use the same named revision/configuration and separate reports.
Explain what combined success still does not establish.
Faulty/corrected experiment and adaptation share one maintained fixture.
dependencies: REX-01; REX-02 for later API recipe
findings.prior_audit_status: Extends present complement/comparison guidance into reusable procedures.

findings.title: Evidence-preservation advice lacks a reusable run record
findings.user_task: Save results that another person can reproduce or compare
findings.observed: Profiles repeatedly ask readers to record versions/configurations/target revisions/bounds/seeds/workloads/database context, but no shared fill-in record or example bundle exists. RTAMT exposes a concrete historical provenance gap.
findings.impact: Ad hoc evidence impedes replay and encourages comparison across mismatched scopes.
findings.recommendation: Provide one human-readable run-record template: tool/version, target revision/digest, host, inputs/config, command, scope/exclusions, relevant data snapshot, outcome, artifacts and evidence status. Allow tool-specific additions without irrelevant mandatory fields.
acceptance_criteria: A sample distinguishes observed from intended output.
Distinguish clean results, findings, setup failure, incomplete analysis and not executed.
Connect commands/artifacts to one target without redefining tool.verified.
Future executed examples retain record and sanitized output.
dependencies: Coordinate authoring/evidence recommendations to avoid competing metadata systems
findings.prior_audit_status: Extends existing instructions; not a false-execution claim.

findings.title: RTAMT first try still lacks an established reproducible environment
findings.observed: The page retains previously reported Python 3.12.14/RTAMT 0.4.10 output without a saved run record and discloses a Python 3.13.15 parser import failure. It then asks for a compatible Python/parser pair without establishing one. Disclosure is accurate.
findings.impact: The arithmetic can be understood, but the wiki does not supply a reproducible known-working environment.
findings.recommendation: Carry this unresolved item forward. In a separately authorized hands-on pass, validate a supported environment and retain dependency pins and both failing/corrected trace outputs. Until then preserve unreproduced status and official setup links; do not guess compatibility or advance verification dates.
acceptance_criteria: A later successful reproduction saves exact environment/dependencies and both outputs.
Setup failure remains distinct from temporal evaluation.
If unavailable, limitation remains prominent and roadmap does not call it resolved.
dependencies: Future hands-on work outside this audit
findings.prior_audit_status: Still open from tool-review/usability audits; not newly discovered.

findings.title: Jazzer PowerShell snippet discards an existing fuzz-mode setting
findings.user_task: Copy the example while preserving surrounding shell state
findings.observed: The snippet assigns JAZZER_FUZZ=1 and removes it afterward instead of restoring an existing value. A reader who had set it loses that state. Static inspection only; Jazzer was not executed.
findings.impact: Small copy/paste side effect can change later test behavior in the same shell.
findings.recommendation: Save previous presence/value and restore in finally, or use a child process with scoped environment.
acceptance_criteria: Initially absent variable returns to absent.
Initially present variable returns to original value.
Cleanup also occurs on command failure.
Retain unexecuted label until validated.
